decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the plans numbered 7266_00, 7266_01, 7266_02, 7266_03, 7266_04, 7266_05, 7266_06, 7266_07, 7266_08, 7266_09, 7266_10 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am and 6pm on Mondays to Saturday and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 6 - The windows and doors formed in the western elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern and western walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority
description: Erection of a three storey front extension, single storey rear extension and second floor rear extension to the house.
